headings: Notice Regarding the Payment of Dividends

On June 17, 2026, the 107th Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders resolved to pay the following year-end dividend for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (April 1, 2025 – March 31, 2026). 1. Year-end Dividend ¥60 per share 2．Effective Date June 18, 2026 (Thursday) A “Year-end Dividend Statement” has been sent to shareholders of record as of March 31, 2026 at their registered address.
